subject: Urgent: West-US checkout errors + latency spike — request for geo-swap
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@brightline.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: 2029-05-23T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: High 502s & token latency — west-us degradation

Hi Laura / Vanessa,

We started seeing a big jump in 502s and token-level latency across our checkout flows hitting west-us (az-west-2) starting ~08:45 PDT. Customers are seeing timeouts and retries; several payments failed. Our telemetry shows a 502 spike to ~9% and median token latency jumping from 60ms to 420ms for a large subset of traffic.

Can Redwood immediately route Brightline traffic away from west-us? We need a short-term mitigation while you investigate. We are on a hard SLO for checkout latency and this is causing a major incident on our end.

I attached a short sample of error responses and timestamps (error-samples.txt).

Samir
Head of Platform
Brightline

On Thu, May 23, 2029 at 9:18 AM Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai> wrote:
> 
> Immediate plan: Im kicking off a geo-traffic swap to route Brightline traffic off west-us to our primary failover region (us-east-2).

Weve started the prep work on our side. Quick technical summary:
- Observed root cause (prelim): kernel saturation on the attention-optimized runtime in west-us when sequence-length mix spiked; node-level queues increased, producing memory pressure and 502s.
- Action taken: pre-warmed the us-east-2 pool with identical model revision + quantization profile, validated KV cache priming step.
- Routing change: switching Brightline routing policy to "latency-first-failover" and applying a 0.9 -> 0.1 weight shift over 6 minutes to avoid amplification.
- Expected impact: error rate should drop to <1% after reroute stabilizes; token latency may be higher by ~10–20% initially due to cold KV caches.

Commands issued (ops):
- rbctl routing update --customer BR-202305-12 --policy latency-first-failover --weight-us-east-2 0.9 --ramp 6m
- rbctl pool scale --region us-east-2 --customer BR-202305-12 --replicas +2 --temp-burst

Im watching the rollout now. Will post metrics when the first stable window shows up.

—Jordan
Principal Engineer, Runtime
Jordan Blake | jordan_blake@redwood.ai

(Attached runbook referenced above.)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>

Date: 2029-05-23T09:29:40-07:00
Subject: Re: High 502s & token latency — west-us degradation

Updating the thread with live ops notes:
- Started routing ramp to us-east-2 at 09:26 PDT. Current split ~70% -> us-east-2, 30% still hitting west-us; were ramping at the 6m schedule.
- Observed error spike in us-east-2 during first minute (mostly cache-miss related 503/504) but now decaying.
- Current metrics (rolling 1m): errors 1.8%, median token latency 210ms for Brightline traffic across both regions.

Risk note: cache miss + model warmup may increase token spend temporarily and adds a small variance to latency. If Brightline requires firm latency SLAs we should enable temporary Dedicated burst capacity (+2 replicas) in us-east-2 for 45–90 minutes. That needs exec/finance sign-off for a one-time capacity bump.

Ive opened incident INC-88921 in PagerDuty and a support ticket (RT #5234). If someone from finance can rubber-stamp a one-time credit, that will help the customer and accelerate remediation.

—Rishi
SRE Lead, Redwood Inference

- Error rate has fallen from ~9% to ~1.5% (rolling 1m); median token latency dropped to ~200–220ms. We will continue to monitor and finish the ramp to 100% if metrics hold.
- Rishi notes there may be a short-lived latency delta due to KV cache priming; Jordan and SRE are keeping an eye on it.

Customer support / remediation: Vanessa and I will follow up with a formal support ticket and a proposed one-time goodwill credit (were proposing 15%, subject to finance approval) for the outage window.

2) Engineering to run post-mortem on west-us runtime saturation and deliver a mitigations plan within 48 hours.
3) I will put together the customer-facing incident summary and route it to Samir and his leadership.

Thanks for raising this — well keep you posted every 10 minutes until stable.
